local allowedOutfitInputs = {
	OutfitName = true,
	Hat1 = true,
	Hat2 = true,
	Hat3 = true,
	Shirt = true,
	Pants = true,
	Face = true,
	Package = true,
	RPName = true,

	RemoveShirt = true,
}

function checkOutfit(plr,inputs,wearonly) --don't check outfit name if wearonly == true
	local statuses = {}
	if type(inputs) ~= "table" then
		statuses["__request"] = "invalid"
		return statuses
	end
	for key,value in pairs(inputs) do
		if allowedOutfitInputs[key] ~= true then
			statuses["__request"] = "invalid"
			return statuses
		end
		if (key == "OutfitName" or key == "RPName" or key == "RPDesc") and value ~= nil and type(value) ~= "string" then
			statuses[key] = "invalid"
			return statuses
		end
		if key == "RemoveShirt" and value ~= nil and type(value) ~= "boolean" then
			statuses[key] = "invalid"
			return statuses
		end
		if key ~= "OutfitName" and key ~= "RPName" and key ~= "RPDesc" and key ~= "RemoveShirt" and value ~= nil and type(value) ~= "string" and type(value) ~= "number" then
			statuses[key] = "invalid"
			return statuses
		end
	end
